# x402-classes

> Class and session booking server: fitness studios and workshop hosts sell seats per-class via x402

x402-classes is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/x402-classes/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference

- [API](https://github.com/nirholas/x402-classes/blob/HEAD/README.md#api)
